info.title: Euron RAGKit
info.description:
Build, measure and serve retrieval pipelines.

Authenticate with the session cookie set by `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, or with
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` using a session token or a project API key (`rgk_...`).
Every error uses one envelope: `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "details?"}}`.

pipeline_version.title: Pipeline Version

pipeline.description: Configuration of version 1. Defaults apply when omitted.

baseline_run_id.description: Defaults to the dataset's baseline run.

shared_with.title: Shared With
shared_with.description: Other versions that use this index.

temporary_password.title: Temporary Password
temporary_password.description: Set only when the account was created by this call. Shown once.

activate.title: Activate
activate.description: Make it the active version now.

pipeline_version.title: Pipeline Version
pipeline_version.description: Defaults to the collection's active version.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: How many candidates each stage produced.

RetrievalOverrides.title: RetrievalOverrides
RetrievalOverrides.description: Per-request changes to a version's retrieval defaults. Index settings are fixed.

token.title: Token
token.description: Also set as an httponly cookie; use either.
